 Todd Monken announced Sanders will start Sunday against the Saints with Watson listed as questionable

 Many people view Patrick Mahomes as one of the best player in the NFL today. While Rod Woodson acknowledges hes an outstanding player, he says he is "a vehicle of the Chiefs offense."
 The Shedeur Sanders era in Cleveland is starting (again), and there may not be anyone more fired up about it than Sanders and his social media team.
 With starter Deshaun Watson questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, head coach Todd Monken announced that Sanders — who started seven games in his rookie campaign last year — will get the nod.
 And you know what that means? It's time for a Shedeur Sanders hype video!

 Nothing wrong with hyping yourself up ... but this has to be the first time a backup quarterback has produced his own.
 Who knows whether this was Sanders' call or if his social media team went rogue and didn't read the room.
 It's good you're fired up, but do you know what sentence has never been uttered?: "Oh, hell yeah; the backup is playing!"
 Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders looks on during warm-ups before an NFL regular-season game against the Tennessee Titans at Nissan Stadium in Nashville, Tenn., on Oct. 25, 2026. (Stephen Furst/Cal Sport Media/Sipa USA via Reuters Connect) 
 Also, I really want to know how long they've been sitting on that video, just waiting for the perfect opportunity to unleash it.
 The reaction on social media was a combination of perplexity and befuddlement.
 THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! 
 "Perfuddlement," as it were.
 I guess in the end there's nothing wrong with being hyped, and if Sanders can lead the Browns to a win on Sunday, I'm sure fans will be more than happy to have as many of them as he wants.
 Of course, the Saints aren't likely to be the toughest opponent the Browns will face this season, but it's still a big game for them as far as the AFC North playoff picture is concerned.
 Shedeur Sanders is slated to start for a Browns team that is still very much in the playoff picture. (Barry Reeger-Imagn Images) 
 The Browns are currently in third place, but from the first-place 6-2 Steelers down to the 4-5 Ravens, there's still enough time for this to go anyone's way.
 Sanders has a chance to help keep his team in that race, and we'll see how that pans out soon enough.

 One thing is for sure: he'll be hyped.
